x-bump-note: 1.1.0 -> 1.2.0 dropped the `null` arm from `suggested_priority` (was `anyOf: [enum, null]`, now a plain closed enum) — review finding: the field's own description already argues absence covers 'no suggestion', so `null` was a second, redundant representation of that state. Classified MAJOR because a document that previously set `suggested_priority: null` explicitly now fails validation; no on-disk corpus was found using that value as of this bump (grepped state/ and docs/ 2026-07-27), so the practical blast radius is believed zero, but the schema's stated domain narrowed. 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 added the optional top-level `suggested_priority` scalar (advisory EM priority signal, C2).
description: Roadmap — forward horizon/portfolio overview record. Validates OVERVIEW.md files only; spinoff-roadmap stub cross-field rules ride on the handoff schema.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Example-repo portfolio vocabulary: planning/active/blocked/shipped/archived. Roadmap-planning OVERVIEW vocabulary: draft/shape-approved/final-approved.

owner.description: Owner identifier (person or team) responsible for this roadmap.

items.description: Plan slugs or stub_ids this roadmap tracks.

blocked_by.description: roadmap_id values this roadmap is gated by.

roadmap_id.description: Unique identifier for this roadmap node.

stub_id.description: Stub code identifier (e.g. Example-initiative-3) used in cross-references.

shape_approved_by.description: Identifier of who approved the shape.

final_approved_by.description: Identifier of who gave final approval.

initiative.description: FK to state/initiatives/<id>.yaml. Nullable — absent or null means this roadmap is not yet attached to a named initiative. A non-null value must be a non-empty initiative id (e.g. 'example-fleet-pro-launch'). Spec backlink: docs/plans/2026-07-04-initiative-govern-sweep-prioritize-doe-d.md § C0

suggested_priority.description: Advisory execution-priority signal an EM may attach to this roadmap at authoring time. Optional (not nullable — absence already covers 'no suggestion'; a redundant null representation was reviewed out, see Finding 4 / review-integrator 2026-07-27). Enum is the priority-ledger domain (priority-ledger.schema.json's urgent|high|medium|low|none) MINUS 'none' — an EM has no reason to author an explicit clear; absence of the field already covers that case. Advisory only: the PM-owned priority ledger (state/priority-ledger/) is the authoritative tier and lives on a deliberately separate surface — this field never overrides it, and that separation (not memory) is what keeps 'advisory never overrides authoritative' structural. Do NOT add a pm_priority field to this frontmatter to compensate; the tier split is the point. NEGATIVE-SPEC: no inherited_from / priority_predecessor field is permitted on this frontmatter either — priority does not chain roadmap-to-roadmap. No backfill of pre-existing roadmaps, consistent with the handoff schema's origin_* no-backfill policy.
